0022600149.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, 0-4 and on a four-game losing streak, sit 14th in the West and host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 2-3 and have lost three straight, sitting 7th in the East. New Orleans is missing Dejounte Murray (out, personal reason), Jordan Poole (out, ankle) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Pelicans lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
